name: Lampedusa e Linosa (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and blue.
history: Municipal flag of Lampedusa e Linosa, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 2 September 1988.
